2609.27717.title: SkillGym: Internalizing Human Skills into LLMs for Real-World Problem Solving
2609.27717.paper_summary: Human-written agent skills encode rich workflows for real-world problem solving, but are typically used as external inference-time instructions rather than internalized as reusable model capabilities. We introduce \texttt{SkillGym}, a framework that transforms these skills into executable, verifiable training environments for large language model agents. Its skill-to-task pipeline instantiates concrete tasks, verifies outcomes with code-based checkers, and assesses empirical skill dependence through contrastive executions. We construct and release 2,756 environments across 12 categories and collect 8,364 successful trajectories from multiple models and harnesses, averaging 49 tool calls and over 60k logged text tokens. These resources support supervised fine-tuning on verified workflows and reinforcement learning with outcome-based rewards. Under Claude Code, supervised fine-tuning improves Qwen3.5-35B-A3B by 199 Elo on GDPval-AA v2, 19.10 percentage points on Terminal-Bench 2.1, and 28.13 and 12.38 points on SkillsBench v1.1 with and without skills, respectively. Our 35B \texttt{SkillGym-Agent} reaches 51.47\% on skill-assisted SkillsBench, exceeding reported scores for Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.4 Mini, and DeepSeek V4 Pro. Without skills, it also surpasses skill-assisted bases under Codex and Claude Code, suggesting reusable procedural competence.
2609.27717.paper_summary_zh: 人類撰寫的代理技能編碼了豐富的工作流程，用於解決現實世界的問題，但通常作為外部推理時的指令使用，而不是內化為可重用的模型能力。我們介紹了 \texttt{SkillGym}，這是一個將這些技能轉化為可執行、可驗證的訓練環境的框架，專為大型語言模型代理設計。其技能到任務的管道實例化具體任務，通過基於代碼的檢查器驗證結果，並通過對比執行評估經驗技能依賴性。我們構建並發布了 2,756 個環境，涵蓋 12 個類別，並從多個模型和工具中收集了 8,364 條成功的軌跡，平均 49 次工具調用和超過 60,000 條記錄的文本標記。這些資源支持在經過驗證的工作流程上進行監督微調，以及基於結果的強化學習。在 Claude Code 下，監督微調使 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 在 GDPval-AA v2 上提高了 199 Elo，在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上提高了 19.10 個百分點，在 SkillsBench v1.1 上分別提高了 28.13 和 12.38 分（有技能和無技能）。我們的 35B \texttt{SkillGym-Agent} 在技能輔助的 SkillsBench 上達到 51.47\%，超過了 Claude Sonnet 4.6、GPT-5.4 Mini 和 DeepSeek V4 Pro 的報告分數。沒有技能的情況下，它也超越了 Codex 和 Claude Code 下的技能輔助基準，這表明可重用的程序能力。
